description: This file defines classes and functions related to building and configuring EFI system partitions (ESP) for different platforms such as Android, Linux, and Fuchsia within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes class declarations for various ESP builders, utility functions for filesystem creation, and checks for ESP generation capability.

classes.name: AndroidEfiLoaderEspBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating Android EFI loader ESP images, allowing configuration of EFI loader path and architecture.

classes.name: LinuxEspBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating Linux EFI system partitions, supporting setting kernel arguments, root, kernel, initrd, and architecture.

classes.name: FuchsiaEspBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating Fuchsia EFI system partitions, supporting configuration of multiboot binary, zedboot, and architecture.

methods.name: EfiLoaderPath
methods.description: Sets the EFI loader path for AndroidEfiLoaderEspBuilder.

methods.name: Architecture
methods.description: Sets the architecture for AndroidEfiLoaderEspBuilder, LinuxEspBuilder, and FuchsiaEspBuilder.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Builds the respective EFI partition or loader image.

methods.name: Argument
methods.description: Adds an argument to the LinuxEspBuilder configuration.

methods.name: Root
methods.description: Sets the root filesystem for LinuxEspBuilder.

methods.name: Kernel
methods.description: Sets the kernel image for LinuxEspBuilder.

methods.name: Initrd
methods.description: Sets the initial ramdisk for LinuxEspBuilder.

methods.name: MultibootBinary
methods.description: Sets the multiboot binary for FuchsiaEspBuilder.

methods.name: Zedboot
methods.description: Sets the zedboot image for FuchsiaEspBuilder.
